name: Dexmedetomidine
metabolism: Direct N-glucuronidation and oxidation, especially through CYP2A6, produce metabolites; N-methylation also occurs. Little unchanged drug is eliminated; urinary metabolites dominate clearance.
summary: Dexmedetomidine is a sedative medication and alpha-2 adrenergic receptor agonist. It is used for sedation in people and animals and for acute agitation associated with schizophrenia or bipolar disorder.
